name: How can current interest rates affect the growth of my investment property portfolio?

mainEntity.name: How can current interest rates affect the growth of my investment property portfolio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current interest rates significantly influence the cost of borrowing for investment properties, directly impacting your profitability and growth potential. Higher interest rates increase monthly mortgage payments, which can reduce your cash flow and overall return on investment. Conversely, lower rates make financing more affordable, allowing for potentially higher returns or the ability to acquire more properties. Understanding the impact of interest rate fluctuations is crucial for timing your purchases and refinancing decisions. Kelby Contreras monitors these economic factors to advise on optimal investment strategies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interest rates affect borrowing costs, impacting profitability and growth. Higher rates reduce cash flow, while lower rates make financing more affordable.
